questions: Have you noticed progressive weakness in your legs over weeks to months?
Do you have any difficulty walking, such as tripping or foot drop?
Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or sensory changes in your legs?
Do you have any difficulty with bowel or bladder control?
Have you had any back pain or trauma preceding the onset of weakness?
Has this leg weakness been present since childhood or many years, rather than recent?
Were you diagnosed with polio as a child or young adult?
Do any of your close blood relatives have similar leg weakness or thin legs?
Have you noticed any weakness in your hands or arms as well?
Do you experience leg weakness that worsens with walking or standing and improves with rest?
Have you noticed any pain, cramping, or fatigue in your leg muscles with activity?
Do you have any history of heart disease, peripheral vascular disease, or risk factors like diabetes, hypertension, or smoking?
Did the leg weakness come on suddenly, over hours or days, rather than gradually?
Can you walk on your heels normally, or does your foot catch on the ground?
Have you had any recent surgery, prolonged bed rest, or prolonged leg crossing?
Do you have any history of diabetes, even mild or borderline?
Do you experience stiffness, heaviness, or tightening in your legs rather than true weakness?
Have you noticed any difficulty initiating walking or a feeling that your legs drag or catch?
Have you noticed any urgency, hesitancy, or retention of urine?
Do you have any cognitive symptoms, memory loss, or changes in thinking?
Have you noticed any tremor or stiffness in your hands?
Do you experience worsening of symptoms with heat, hot weather, or hot baths?
Have you ever had blurred vision, pain with eye movement, or loss of vision in one eye?
Do you feel a shock-like sensation down your spine or legs when you bend your neck forward?
Have you noticed any double vision or facial weakness or numbness?
Have you had any episodes where your leg symptoms got much worse for days or weeks and then partly recovered?
